activities.label: Learn
activities.title: Your lesson model
activities.body: Read the explanation, then answer the next question from memory.

essentialIdeas: ATP transfers usable energy by releasing a phosphate group during hydrolysis.

activities.concept: ATP transfers usable energy by releasing a phosphate group during hydrolysis.
activities.label: Explain
activities.title: ATP energy release
activities.body: How does ATP transfer usable energy in cells?
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers usable energy when its terminal phosphate is removed by hydrolysis, converting ATP to ADP and phosphate.
activities.feedback: ATP’s energy transfer depends on phosphate removal, not breaking the whole molecule apart.

activities.concept: ATP transfers usable energy by releasing a phosphate group during hydrolysis.
activities.label: Repair
activities.title: Repair the first explanation
activities.body: Compare the first explanation with this verified reference: ATP transfers usable energy when its terminal phosphate is removed by hydrolysis, converting ATP to ADP and phosphate. Correct the exposed relationship in your own words without copying the reference.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers usable energy when its terminal phosphate is removed by hydrolysis, converting ATP to ADP and phosphate.
activities.feedback: ATP’s energy transfer depends on phosphate removal, not breaking the whole molecule apart.

activities.concept: ATP transfers usable energy by releasing a phosphate group during hydrolysis.
activities.label: Explain again
activities.title: Explain the corrected relationship again
activities.body: How does ATP transfer usable energy in cells? Explain it again after the repair without copying the model or reference answer.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers usable energy when its terminal phosphate is removed by hydrolysis, converting ATP to ADP and phosphate.
activities.feedback: ATP’s energy transfer depends on phosphate removal, not breaking the whole molecule apart.

activities.concept: Recognition transfer: ATP transfers usable energy by releasing a phosphate group during hydrolysis.
activities.label: Recall check
activities.title: ATP energy transfer
activities.body: Which statement best describes ATP energy transfer?
choices: ATP transfers usable energy when a phosphate group is removed by hydrolysis.
ATP stores energy only after oxygen is used in respiration.
ATP becomes energy when it gains an extra sugar.
ATP transfers energy by splitting into two identical molecules.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers usable energy when a phosphate group is removed by hydrolysis.
activities.feedback: ATP releases usable energy through phosphate removal, not the other changes listed.
